_meta.purpose: One function = one screen, one route, one menu entry, one table/model, one API. Single source of truth against duplicate builds (docs/plan/R1-START-HERE.md "No duplicates (enforced by CI)").
_meta.generator: node scripts/r1-canonical-map.mjs --write (code-derived fields); statuses, notes, api_id, approved_by_card, concepts are hand-set and kept
_meta.approval: A NEW route/menu/model/API that the scope guard flags as a possible duplicate needs: a DM-/API- ID in the PR body AND "approved_by_card": "<this PR's card id>" on its entry here.
_meta.register: Decisions follow the V3 duplicates register (D113): all entries decided, none pending.
_meta.excluded: Not listed on purpose: bottom-nav / "Lagi" popover / tab bars (views of listed items), out-of-scope.ts (a filter), pembelajaran-nav.ts (derived from user-nav), mock server routes (src/mock/**), dev galleries are listed with their /__ paths.
_meta.sector_source: .github/CODEOWNERS (including the commented sector templates; last match wins; S0 = platform default)

findings.title: Two admin menus
findings.detail: src/shells/nav/admin-nav.ts (ADMIN_NAV, F-18 AdminShell) and src/shells/pentadbiran/menu.ts both define the Admin Pusat menu; layouts.ts adminShellFor() already sends role admin to the Pentadbiran portal.
findings.decision: D113: src/shells/pentadbiran/menu.ts is the only admin menu; all admin-nav.ts items and the admin-only user-nav.ts items have status retire.

findings.title: user-nav carries admin-only copies
findings.detail: USER_NAV has admin-only entries (ids guru-*, admin-*, urus-hadiah, admin-tebusan, kelulusan-hadiah) that Admin Pusat does not render.

findings.title: Leaderboard in two pages and two APIs
findings.detail: /leaderboard and /gamification/leaderboard; GET /api/leaderboard and GET /api/gamification/leaderboard (plus /api/rankings and /api/battle/standings, which are separate screens).
findings.decision: D113: /leaderboard + GET /api/leaderboard are canonical; the other two are redirect / retire.

findings.title: Two reward catalogues
findings.detail: rewards + reward_redemptions (shop) versus syiling_rewards + reward_claims (Kawalan Reward only).
findings.decision: D113: rewards + reward_redemptions canonical; syiling_rewards and reward_claims legacy-retire.

findings.title: Second mock-exam product
findings.detail: spm_mock_exams, spm_mock_exam_items, /spm-mock*, /api/spm-mocks next to Bijak papers; listed twice in the pupil menu.
findings.decision: D113: /spm-mock redirects to /spm/bijak; tables legacy-retire; /api/spm-mocks retire.

findings.title: Answer facts in about nine tables
findings.detail: attempt_answers, structured_attempts, battle_answers, game_session_items, spm_mock_exam_items, pksk_exam_attempts, audio_kbat_attempts, remedial_test_items next to practice_answers.
findings.decision: D113: practice_answers is the single store (modes structured, battle, pksk, audio_kbat added); the others are parallel-of:PracticeAnswer sidecars, no new answer table.

findings.title: Placeholder preview routes shadow real routes
findings.detail: core-routes.ts registers /admin (dev.preview-hub-admin) and /dashboard (dev.preview-hub-user) although the real routes exist (D20 temporary placeholders).
findings.decision: D113: retire; previewHubRoutes() and its call are deleted (S0-T05, FR-X2-0)

findings.title: Two front-end HTTP clients for the same admin endpoints
findings.detail: m28-bijak-spm/server/http-admin.ts versus m04-question-bank/api/questions.ts. Not detectable by the map.
findings.decision: D113: the client in the owning module stays; the other becomes a re-export, then is deleted.

concepts.description: A single exam / practice question with versions, parts, options and DSKP tags (one store, many role views).

concepts.note: Register M-01 / M-06 / section 6: three lists and three editors exist today; no fourth list, no second question table, no new endpoint family. Sub-entities of the question (version, part, option) are the only models allowed to contain the word "question".
